name: foldlab-reference
description: Local reference corpus for provenance, Effect language semantics, Schema JSON source notes, and supporting evidence.
invariants: Every listed path exists relative to .reference (moved context documents resolve through ../docs).
Canonical terms live in exactly one CONTEXT.md.
Canonical source pins live only in provenance/sources.lock.json.
The catalog classifies evidence but does not own pins or semantic definitions.
Source surface notes do not establish accepted project scope.
Project-owned semantic code is defined as a typed functional core before external adapters are admitted.
Every soundness claim names and proves the exact relation it preserves.
Agent bootstrap files remain outside this manifest.

addDocument: Place the document under its owning module or catalog.
Add it to the owning module interface or sharedEvidence when it is externally navigable.
moveDocument: Update manifest.json before removing the old path.
Update MANIFEST.md and inbound links in the same change.
changePin: Verify commit, tree, blob, content digest, and byte length.
Update dependent catalog notes without duplicating the canonical pin.
changeTerm: Update references to the old term in the same change.
